provenance.derivation: closed charge-balance model, bisection on pH in [-2, 16]
provenance.independentCheckMethod: expected pH values recomputed with a standalone solver written directly from spec §7-§9 before the engine existed; all eight agreed exactly

cases.title: Chưa thêm base
cases.notes: Pure 0.01000 mol/L HCl. D = (nCl - nNa)/V = 0.01 mol/L, so pH = -log10(0.01) exactly.

cases.title: NaOH 22.50 mL (trước điểm tương đương)
cases.notes: Excess acid branch: D = (2.5e-4 - 2.25e-4)/0.0475 L = 5.263158e-4 mol/L.

cases.title: NaOH 25.00 mL (đúng đương lượng)
cases.notes: D = 0, so h = sqrt(Kw) with pKw = 13.990 giving pH = 13.990/2. This is the benchmark target.

cases.title: Ca(OH)2 27.50 mL (dư base)
cases.notes: Excess base with the CaOH+ complex retained in the charge balance.

cases.title: Na2CO3 25.00 mL (hai đương lượng danh nghĩa, hệ kín)
cases.notes: Exactly two nominal equivalents yet far from target: the closed carbonate system holds carbon as CO2*. The pedagogical point of this case. Alpha values from spec §15.1.

cases.title: Na2CO3 42.25 mL (đạt target trong hệ kín)
cases.notes: alpha1 + 2*alpha2 must equal (nNa - nCl)/CT = 2.565056e-3 / 3.141264e-3 = 0.816567424. This is the independent cross-check on the carbonate speciation. Alpha values from spec §15.1.

cases.title: Ca(OH)2 25.00 mL (đúng đương lượng)
cases.notes: Below the NaOH stoichiometric value of 6.995 because CaOH+ consumes hydroxide. An implementation ignoring hydrolysis would report 6.995 here.

cases.title: NaOH 27.50 mL rồi hiệu chỉnh HCl 2.50 mL
cases.notes: Correction returns D to zero, so pH equals the stoichiometric value. Cost index 0.300/0.2500 = 1.200. Safety 100 - 15 = 85: the excess-base penalty must NOT fire because base equivalents equal exactly 1.1 x E*, and the comparison is strict.
